name: Avatar of Wardens
description:
You gain +0.5 step height and can sense enemies via their [blue]vibrations[/blue], causing you to [effect:wardenanger][dark-red]anger[/dark-red][/effect]. Once fully angered, you gain the following effects:

  • +1♥️ attack damage and +10% speed

  • Right click periodically to release a 5♥️ [blue]sonic boom[/blue]

  • Shift punch the block below you to burrow, healing 2♥️ and calming your [dark-red]anger[/dark-red]

effects.explanation: You can gain anger every 3 seconds, stacking 4 times.
